selection: highest VAL macro average precision over the required labels among the fine-tuned candidates
a: the selected model beats BOTH baselines (label prior, frozen CLIP linear probe) on VAL macro-AP (required labels)
b: for every required label, VAL AP > VAL prevalence + 0.1
c: TEST is evaluated exactly once, after selection, by `finalize`, and reported whatever it shows
optional_labels: Privacy Zuckering, Pay to Avoid Ad are shown only if VAL AP > prevalence + 0.1 and a threshold with VAL precision >= 0.7 exists
thresholds: per label, highest-F1 VAL threshold with VAL precision >= 0.7; otherwise the label is 'not reliable' and never shown
